headline: IMF warns of potential AI economic bubble
standfirst: The global financial watchdog says AI hype could lead to a damaging market correction.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: The IMF warned that the current AI investment bubble could burst and hurt the global economy.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Massive spending on AI technology has created financial instability and mounting debt concerns.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: A sudden drop in AI market value could rattle global financial stability beyond just tech.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Experts are also tracking how rising cyberattack risks could further complicate this situation.

caption:
The International Monetary Fund is warning that the AI bubble might pose a threat to the global economy.

Financial watchdogs are concerned that heavy investment in AI is creating an unstable market environment. Beyond the debt risks, they note that cyberattacks are adding significant pressure to the sector.
